entries.name: Nightclub

the entrance is where guests enter and exit the nightclub.

the main show area is where the main stage is, the main stage has two pole dancing poles on it for Frenni and Bonfie to use.

the Kitchen is where all the food and non alcoholic drinks are made. it has a brick oven for Chiku to bake pizza in.

the bar is where the alcoholic drinks and desserts are made. there are several bottles of alcoholic drinks for Fexa to serve to the guests.

the prize counter is where guests can purchase gifts with money, or the tokens they get from winning the games in the arcade. there are several different gifts for Marie to hand out to the guests.

the east hall connects the main show area to the arcade, and the private show room.

the entrance, prize counter, and the bar are all connected to the main show area.

the security room is connected to both the east hall, and the west hall.

there are also several vents that run through the entire building.
